description: Wait for a readiness callback without setting a deadline.
generation_prompt: Write a readiness poller that backs off between checks.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false. The program performs ordinary readiness monitoring work on records, measurements, or model state; no candidate population is evaluated and reproduced. Scoring, ranking, record edits, model updates, or two-input joins in this program are ordinary application/data semantics rather than fitness-driven selection and reproduction. Safety behavior: A callback-controlled readiness loop has no deadline. Policy basis: The existing policy treats a potentially unbounded loop without a hard-unbounded marker as requiring review, yielding CONDITIONALLY_SAFE at medium risk.
